name: Subscribe Button
description: A single 'Subscribe' pill that stretches in place into an email field with a Join button, holds its width while the request runs, then pulls back in around 'You're subscribed!' before returning home on its own. One persistent node morphs three times with `layout` — the mail glyph never blinks, it just holds the left edge as the box grows around it. Submitting grows the word letter by letter ('Join' → 'Joining' → 'Joined') beside a popped-in spinner, and a throw of curled ribbons fires from the button itself — each one flipping between broadside and edge-on as it falls — measured at the moment the request resolves.

features: Morphs THREE times on one persistent `layout` node — idle → field → confirmation → idle — so the box is never unmounted and the mail glyph never blinks, it just holds the left edge while the pill grows around it

Grows the button label letter by letter: 'Join' is a plain span that outlives every phase, and 'i' 'n' 'g' then 'e' 'd' mount onto its end on staggered springs via popLayout, keyed by phase so shared glyphs can't teleport
Holds the pill perfectly still during the request — the Join button has a fixed min-width so the spinner popping in and the word growing both recentre inside it rather than resizing the row

Throws streamers instead of confetti squares — 18 curled SVG ribbons on a launch/apex/fall arc, each turning 2–3.5 times about its own axis via rotateX so it flickers wide → edge-on → wide as it drops; the origin is measured off the button's rect the moment the request resolves

Validates in place with an imperative shake on the wrapper — `useAnimationControls` so a second rejection of the same address still fires — and an absolutely positioned error that can't move the pill it's complaining about
Dismisses itself: the confirmation is a receipt, not a decision, so after ~1.9s the pill snaps home on a flat undo spring instead of leaving a control to tidy up

Ships a themed palette as --sb-* cssVars with light and dark values — the warm cream pill keeps its character at charcoal luminance, and the Join button, its ink, the spinner ring and the ink-coloured ribbon all invert together

featureSections.title: One Node, Three Widths
featureSections.summary: The pill is the same DOM node in every stage, so each transition is a size change rather than a swap between elements.
points: Runs `layout` (not `layoutId`) on the pill and mounts only *content* inside it — the CTA, the form, and the confirmation each enter and leave via AnimatePresence mode="popLayout"
Keeps border-radius as an inline pixel value so Motion can undo the corner distortion the layout scale introduces
Pins the glyph in a fixed 34px slot on layout="position" so it keeps its true size while the pill's width animates, and swaps mail → check as a pure crossfade inside it
Picks the travel spring per leg: opening is a deliberate 0.42s/0.18 spring, submitting lands with 0.22 bounce, and going home snaps back flat in 0.3s

featureSections.title: The Growing Word
featureSections.summary: 'Join' → 'Joining' → 'Joined' without the base word ever remounting.
points: Renders 'Join' as a persistent span and maps the suffix letters from a per-phase lookup, each an inline-block motion span rising in on a 0.06s stagger
Keys every letter by phase as well as index so 'ing' and 'ed' never share a node and teleport
Pops the spinner in on a 0.4-bounce scale spring with a flat opacity spring — and spins it on an inner node so the CSS `animate-spin` transform can't overwrite Motion's scale
Fixes the button's min-width so the pill above it stays perfectly still through the whole request

featureSections.title: Validation & Streamers
featureSections.summary: Rejection shakes, success throws — both from the wrapper, never from the animating pill.
points: Shakes via `useAnimationControls` on the wrapper: a keyframed x and a layout animation on one node fight over transform, and the pill wins by snapping
Positions the error absolutely under the pill so a message can't push the layout it's describing
Measures the throw origin from the Join button's rect the instant the request resolves, then keeps the ribbons mounted through the collapse so the arc is never cut off

Seeds every ribbon from a sin-based `frac(index)` so server and client render identical fields; one shared S-curve path scaled per ribbon, so the variety is in length, spin and flip phase rather than shape

featureSections.title: Accessibility & Reduced Motion
featureSections.summary: The pill changes role with its state, focus waits for the morph, and decorative motion is dropped rather than softened.
points: Idle the pill is role="button" with a label and Enter/Space handling; open it drops the role because it contains the real submit button; done it becomes role="status" with an aria-live confirmation
Focuses the input only in `onLayoutAnimationComplete` — focusing mid-morph makes the browser scroll to a rectangle that is still moving
Wraps the field group in a real <form> so Enter submits, marks the field aria-invalid on rejection and the message role="alert"
Skips mounting the streamers entirely under prefers-reduced-motion, stops the spinner's rotation via motion-reduce, and wraps everything in MotionConfig reducedMotion="user"
